experiment: Experiment 76.1 - DCMP-R Refined Disease-Confusion Memory Prompting

base.name: E74.4-G2-Positive-DCR
base.initialization: E61 epoch-10 warmup independently restored for each fold; E74.4 best checkpoints are read-only evaluation references, never initial weights
base.direct_delta: positive-only direct DCR, scale=0.02; unified graph unchanged

memory.probe: five-fold cross-fitted LogisticRegression on initial warmup CAM144; actual OOF errors only, capped at 20% of true class, highest wrong-class confidence first
memory.cluster_algorithm: deterministic KMeans with fold-private random_state and fixed n_init=10
memory.leave_one_out: subtract querying training subject's current feature from its assigned prototype sum/count

prompt.source: official BrainPrompt ABIDE label prompts from audited E72.4 cache

module.query: normalized W_h(CAM144)+0.1*W_t(class-specific BrainPrompt text); temperature 0.10; two-stage balanced class/role retrieval
module.bounded_direction: tanh(composer)/sqrt(144) has norm <= 1; multiply by rho=0.05*sigmoid(g), no post-hoc samplewise clipping
module.support_feature_to_gate: cosine matching strength plus log1p(support)/log1p(871), avoiding raw-count Sigmoid saturation
module.role_confidence: four role-local attentions remain separate; learned confidence combines role evidence, class differences, typical-hard conflicts, support and validity
module.risk_target: cross-fitted training-only actual errors; shared warmup encoder is not strict end-to-end OOF

optimization.new_step_order: DCMP AdamW after the three original optimizers

protocol_limits: Fold 2 historical rows 377 ASD and 407 TD remain in base training and test; excluded from new labeled memory and risk supervision
metrics are mechanism-paired historical-protocol results, not unbiased generalization estimates

preflight_repairs.failure: The code expected patient_count/text_dim at the cache root, but the audited E72.4 file stores these in tensor shape and metadata.

preflight_repairs.failure: E74.4 stores train/test indices as CUDA tensors, which cannot be passed directly to NumPy.
preflight_repairs.repair: Added a single explicit CPU index conversion helper for prototype, checkpoint, and audit paths.

preflight_repairs.failure: The fold prototype-support summary used torch without importing it in that function.

preflight_repairs.failure: Warmup CAM144 and fold labels were on CUDA, but the memory builder intentionally returns its immutable template on CPU.
preflight_repairs.repair: Moved the built template to the active fold device before batched leave-one-out checks and formal dispatch.

preflight_repairs.failure: Strict bitwise equality was too strong for device floating-point gradients: only a module parameter differed by 7.45e-9 and Adam first moment by 1.14e-13; logits, loss, base model/optimizers, memory, and RNG were exact.
preflight_repairs.repair: Use a fixed-order prototype reduction and require DCMP module/optimizer replay within atol=1e-8, rtol=1e-7 while retaining exact base, logits, loss, memory, and RNG checks.

preflight_repairs.failure: run_training referenced torch for device metadata without importing it; no worker was dispatched.
preflight_repairs.repair: Added a local torch import and will re-run the source-locked preflight.

preflight_repairs.failure: Raw prototype support counts in the correction gate reached several hundred and saturated the sigmoid, giving zero classification gradient to DCMP-R.
preflight_repairs.repair: Normalized role support with log1p(support)/log1p(871), kept matching strength on the cosine scale, and initialized the rho output projection to zero with a -4.5 bias so the correction starts near zero without gate saturation.

preflight_repairs.failure: Early mechanism logs showed the dynamic safety clip could pin residuals to the full 5% limit, weakening the registered learned amplitude gate. The run was stopped after 3/30 task files completed; none are accepted as formal results.
preflight_repairs.repair: Bounded each tanh direction by sqrt(144) and removed post-hoc per-sample clipping; added a preflight test requiring a 10x+ residual response when the gate is opened versus closed. Checkpoints and task states from the stopped run were quarantined under .runtime/aborted_attempts and are excluded from formal counts.

execution_attempts.failure: Classification gradients did not reach DCMP-R because raw memory support counts saturated its gate.
execution_attempts.repair: Normalized support statistics and reinitialized the correction gate.

execution_attempts.failure: A fixed 5% norm clip made some learned correction magnitudes stick to the safety bound.
execution_attempts.repair: Removed post-hoc clipping and bounded the tanh direction analytically; incomplete artifacts were quarantined under .runtime/aborted_attempts.
